description.intro: No More Ago replaces relative labels such as “3 months ago” with exact dates when a trustworthy timestamp is available. Existing absolute dates and unrecognized labels stay unchanged.
description.controls: Choose your date format and time zone. Enable the extension globally, exclude individual sites, or run it only on selected sites. Switch between system, light and dark appearance.
description.compatibility: Works with supported standard timestamps and selected website integrations. Compatibility is best-effort: website changes can affect support. Dates without a time remain calendar dates.
description.privacy: Settings stay in your browser. Optional diagnostic logs are stored locally. Bluesky support makes anonymous requests to its public API for public post timestamps. No accounts or telemetry.

release.text: First release: exact dates for supported relative timestamps, date and time-zone settings, site controls, light and dark appearance, and an interface in 40 languages.

replacement.heading: See when it happened
replacement.body: Turn supported relative timestamps into exact dates.

control.heading: Your dates. Your settings.
control.body: Choose the date format, time zone and sites that work for you.

appearance.heading: At home in light and dark
appearance.body: Use the system appearance or choose your preferred theme.
